messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — Zenith updated their ETA window for the April top‑up. They moved ~40 H100s from 'early Apr' to 'mid Apr' and proposed a small hopper fee change. PO 98765 affected.
aj_purchase: Hopper fee change? can you paste the ratecard diff? need numbers to run cost model.
maria_ops: Sure — Zenith sent spreadsheet snippet: `base_unit: $12,500 -> $12,800`, `hopper: $250 -> $350`. They say higher freight/airline surcharges.
aj_purchase: Oof. That increases monthly op-ex by ~3.1% for the Dedicated pool if we accept. Any negotiation room?
zhen_zenith: @maria_ops hi — small context: late season demand + carrier peak. We can hold hopper at $300 if Redwood agrees to take 20% of tonight’s split allocation (40 units) on a delivery commit. Otherwise the $350 stands.
neha_ops: If we accept the split, how does staging look? our AMS depot is already at 85% slot usage. Partial deliveries will force crossdock ops.
cory_infra: Impact on cluster capacity: if those 40 H100s get delayed we need to reshuffle provisioning for EU edge. We have 12 high-priority jobs pinned to those units. Can we evict noncritical workloads?
maria_ops: We could shift training to burst in us-west for 1 week, evict <1% long tail jobs. But need finance sign-off on cost delta from moving traffic.
sophia_finance: Quick calc: moving workloads + expedited freight to keep timeline will ~+$42k vs plan. If Zenith holds $300 hopper we save $4k over their $350. Negotiation seems worth it if ops confirms staging.
aj_purchase: Can we trade an extended payment term instead of taking the 20% split? e.g., net45 -> net60 for the April tranche?
zhen_zenith: We can extend to net60 for the April tranche, but then need a firm landing window within Apr 8-16. The split allocation ask is to cover surge cost from the forwarder.
neha_ops: Apr 8-16 is workable if we get exact pick dates 48h in advance. Also need AWB and carrier so we can book depot slots.
maria_ops: zenith — can you commit to 48h pre-advise + AWB at hand for each sub-shipment? we need that to avoid last-minute crossdock fees.
zhen_zenith: Yes — we'll push for `48h ETA + AWB` per sub-shipment. Sample AWB: `ZYX123456789`.
rma_bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-0042 for PO 98765 (placeholder if DOA discovered on arrival).
cory_infra: Also flagging thermal probes: last batch had 2/200 units with thermal fault after install. Ops needs preflight QA checklist on arrival (photo + temp log) before accept.
neha_ops: noted. we'll require depot photo evidence + serial scan + temp log baseline before sign-off. add to incoming SOP.
sophia_finance: If we accept net60, finance wants an insurance/indemnity clause for carrier surcharges — vendor needs to confirm liability split for AWB rebookings >48h.
zhen_zenith: We'll add indemnity clause for rebookings caused by carrier. Can't cover customs hold fees.
aj_purchase: OK. summary for exec: Vendor offers net60, hopper $300 if we take full allocation; alternatively keep original split ask (take 20% tonight) to keep $300. Ops wants 48h AWB and photo/temp QA. Finance wants indemnity for rebookings.
maria_ops: Action items: 1) aj_purchase to confirm price accept vs split by EOD PST. 2) neha_ops to draft depot SOP snippet for arrival checks. 3) cory_infra to create priority reschedule plan for EU jobs. 4) zhen_zenith to provide firm sub-shipment dates and AWBs 48h prior.
aj_purchase: I'll push for net60 + hopper $300 and try to avoid taking split. will update by 17:00 PST.
zhen_zenith: Acknowledged. I'll block the Apr 8-16 window tentatively and get back with AWB timeline by EOD CET.
rma_bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 72h.
maria_ops: Thanks all — keeping this thread pinned to the vendors channel. :thumbsup:
